title: Normalized adjunction mates commute with comparison squares
statement: Let A,B,C,D and A',B',C',D' be categories, with functors Q_A:A→A', Q_B:B→B', Q_C:C→C', Q_D:D→D'. Let L:A→C, R:B→A, H:B→D, S:D→C have corresponding functors L',R',H',S' between the primed categories. Specify natural isomorphisms l:Q_A⋙L'≅L⋙Q_C, r:Q_B⋙R'≅R⋙Q_A, h:Q_B⋙H'≅H⋙Q_D, s:Q_D⋙S'≅S⋙Q_C, and adjunctions E⊣R', F⊣S'. Let b_K:L(R(K))→S(H(K)) be arrows and β:R'⋙L'→H'⋙S' a natural transformation. Fix P∈A, EP∈B, FP∈D, arrows u:P→R(EP), v:L(P)→S(FP), e:E(Q_A(P))→Q_B(EP), d:F(Q_C(L(P)))→Q_D(FP), and g:H(EP)→FP. Assume η_E≫R'(e)≫r_EP=Q_A(u), η_F≫S'(d)≫s_FP=Q_C(v), β_(Q_B EP)≫S'(h_EP)≫s_(H EP)=L'(r_EP)≫l_(R EP)≫Q_C(b_EP), and L(u)≫b_EP≫S(g)=v. If θ:E⋙H'≅L'⋙F has inverse equal to the mate of β under the two adjunctions, then L'(R'(e)≫r_EP)≫l_(R EP)≫Q_C(b_EP≫S(g)) equals β_(E(Q_A P))≫S'(θ_(Q_A P)≫F(l_P)≫d)≫s_FP. All compositions use the displayed functors and the units of the specified adjunctions; no localization or exactness assumptions are necessary.

proof.text: Transpose θ inverse followed by H′(e), h, and Q_D(g) under F⊣S′. The inverse-mate unit identity unit_mateEquiv_symm moves the source unit across β. Naturality of β and s, the comparison-square hypothesis, and naturality of l turn this transpose into Q_C(L(u)≫b_EP≫S(g)). Use the ordinary unit equation and target unit normalization. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence and cancellation of s yield θ inverse≫H′(e)≫h≫Q_D(g)=F(l_P)≫d.
Substitute this equality into the asserted square. Cancel θ followed by its inverse. Naturality of β and s and the comparison-square hypothesis give the result, using functoriality and associativity.

    (L : A ⥤ C) (R : B ⥤ A) (H : B ⥤ D) (S : D ⥤ C)
    (Ld : AD ⥤ CD) (Rd : BD ⥤ AD) (Hd : BD ⥤ DD) (Sd : DD ⥤ CD)
    (E : AD ⥤ BD) (F : CD ⥤ DD) (a : E ⊣ Rd) (a' : F ⊣ Sd)
    (l : QA ⋙ Ld ≅ L ⋙ QC) (r : QB ⋙ Rd ≅ R ⋙ QA)
    (h : QB ⋙ Hd ≅ H ⋙ QD) (s : QD ⋙ Sd ≅ S ⋙ QC)
    (b : ∀ K, L.obj (R.obj K) ⟶ S.obj (H.obj K)) (bd : Rd ⋙ Ld ⟶ Hd ⋙ Sd)
    (P : A) (EP : B) (FP : D)
    (u : P ⟶ R.obj EP) (v : L.obj P ⟶ S.obj FP)
    (e : E.obj (QA.obj P) ⟶ QB.obj EP)
    (d : F.obj (QC.obj (L.obj P)) ⟶ QD.obj FP)
    (hu : a.unit.app (QA.obj P) ≫ Rd.map e ≫ r.hom.app EP = QA.map u)
    (hv : a'.unit.app (QC.obj (L.obj P)) ≫ Sd.map d ≫ s.hom.app FP = QC.map v)
    (hb : bd.app (QB.obj EP) ≫ Sd.map (h.hom.app EP) ≫ s.hom.app (H.obj EP) =
      Ld.map (r.hom.app EP) ≫ l.hom.app (R.obj EP) ≫ QC.map (b EP))
    (g : H.obj EP ⟶ FP)
    (hg : L.map u ≫ b EP ≫ S.map g = v)
    (θ : E ⋙ Hd ≅ Ld ⋙ F)
    (hθ : θ.inv = ((mateEquiv a a').symm (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ bd)).natTrans) :
    Ld.map (Rd.map e ≫ r.hom.app EP) ≫ l.hom.app (R.obj EP) ≫
        QC.map (b EP ≫ S.map g) =
      bd.app (E.obj (QA.obj P)) ≫
        Sd.map (θ.hom.app (QA.obj P) ≫ F.map (l.hom.app P) ≫ d) ≫ s.hom.app FP
